title: BLUE LOCK
synopsis:
The Japanese national soccer team has long suffered from a lack of scoring power. To break this deadlock, a top-secret project named “Blue Lock” was launched.
Three hundred high school strikers gathered at the facility must undergo numerous trials, with only the final survivor becoming the world's greatest striker. However, the cruel condition was that those eliminated would permanently lose their eligibility to join the national team.
Can the unknown high school player Yoichi Isagi (Fumiya Takahashi) defeat 299 others and become the strongest ace striker!?

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
日本國家足球隊長期飽受前鋒得分能力不足的困擾。為了打破這個僵局，日本足球聯盟啟動了一項機密計劃，名為「藍色監獄（Blue Lock）」。
300名來自全國各地的高中前鋒被召集到這座封閉設施，接受一連串殘酷且激烈的選拔與考驗。在這場競爭中，只有最後存活下來的一人，才能成為世界第一前鋒。然而，計劃亦設下無情規則：所有被淘汰的球員，將永遠失去加入日本國家隊的資格。
平凡的高中足球員潔世一（高橋文哉 飾），能否在與299名天才前鋒的激烈競爭中脫穎而出，戰勝所有對手，成為最強王牌射手？
